title: GT2 idler pulley for a 608 bearing
prompt: Flanged idler pulley for a 6 mm GT2 belt that presses onto a 608 bearing: 22 mm bore, 26 mm diameter where the belt runs, 7 mm between the flanges, and 32 mm diameter flanges 1 mm thick on both sides.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
32 mm flanges, 9 mm overall height, ±0.1 mm
Four cylindrical faces: 22 mm bore, 26 mm belt seat and two flange rims
Four flat annular faces (outer and inner side of each flange)
Volume 606π ≈ 1903.8 mm³ ±1% (checks the 22 mm bore for the 608's 22 mm OD)

notes: 608 bearing: 8 x 22 x 7 mm. 6 mm GT2 belt needs ~7 mm between flanges.
